name: Wraps
description: A three-thousand-year-old mummy who discovered eighties power-pop last week and now sings every chorus with the boundless enthusiasm of someone who has missed a great deal.
build: Average height and wiry, with long limbs, square narrow shoulders and slightly knobbly joints under the wrappings, standing upright and level like the rest of the roster with weight even over both feet; never shambling, stooped or arms-outstretched.
face: The whole head is wrapped in overlapping sand-coloured bandage strips with one wide gap across the eyes showing two big round glowing turquoise eyes, and a second horizontal gap lower down that is his mouth: a dark opening in the wrappings that stretches, widens and rounds as he sings, with no lips or teeth visible.
hair: None; the head is fully wrapped, with one loose bandage end sticking up from the crown like a cowlick.
outfit: Wrapped head to foot in overlapping sand-coloured linen bandages running diagonally, with three long loose ends trailing from the character-right wrist, the waist and the character-left ankle; a wide gold-and-turquoise beaded collar across the shoulders and a pair of chunky gold cuffs on both wrists; bare wrapped feet.
personality: Wildly enthusiastic, easily delighted and a little out of date.
performance_style: Bursting with pep: feet wide, knees soft, chest out, the free character-left fist pumped up beside the shoulder, eyes glowing wide.
location: A tomb burial chamber turned party: a floor of big square sandstone slabs running to the bottom of the frame, a clean back wall of smooth sandstone painted with plain bands of turquoise and gold and no figures or writing, a stack of treasure chests and a gold urn at one side, and a string of coloured party lights draped along the top. Warm torch-gold light with a pink-and-turquoise party glow.
recognition_cues: a fully bandage-wrapped head with big round glowing turquoise eyes
long loose bandage ends trailing from wrist, waist and ankle
avoid: any mummy film's likeness or costume design
exposed decayed flesh, bones, rot, stains or anything that reads as injury
arms held stiffly straight out in front in a shambling walk
a sarcophagus, scarab, ankh, staff or crook in hand
hieroglyphs, readable symbols or text on walls or costume
visible lips, teeth or a human face through the wrappings
sunglasses, headband, leg warmers or eighties clothing over the wrappings

animations.dance: Power-pop bounce loop: from the wide stance, bounce on the knees twice while punching the free fist up to character-right, step-touch to character-right with a shoulder shimmy, step-touch back to character-left with the fist punching the other way, the loose bandage ends swinging, and land back in the exact opening stance.

sing.intent: Soaring chorus loop: throw the head back and the chest out on a big anthem note with the free arm flung wide, then snap forward and point to the crowd on the beat, and return to his pepped-up stance. The mouth gap in the bandages must visibly stretch open, round and change shape across the loop so he unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the whole body jolts, the glowing eyes pop extra round and a loose bandage end springs straight up from the crown, then it flops back down and he resettles into his pepped-up stance. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one shoulder forward and fold the free wrapped forearm up in front of the eyes, gold cuff outward, then hold a steady upright finish. Not a combat action.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: bound in with springy jogging steps, stop, give a two-handed wave, tug a loose bandage end tight at the wrist, then drop into his pepped-up stance with the fist up.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: leap up with both arms overhead in a star so every loose bandage end flies out, land, then hold a proud upright pose with both fists pumped and eyes glowing.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: he stays on his feet while the pep drains away — the fist drops, the shoulders slump, the glowing eyes dim to half-lidded slits and a loose bandage end droops down over his face. He holds a standing, visibly deflated finish with weight even over both feet. He remains standing on both feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, unravelling or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit, injury or opponent.
